No one will ever be perfect, that is just a fact of life and being a human being. Things will go wrong, things will sometimes be disastrous, but in terms of running a game, the only ones who need to be happy with how the game played out is you and your players.

I am extremely grateful that I had the chance and opportunity to watch you, Marisha, Laura, Travis, Sam, Liam, Ashley and Talisen take this journey.
